# Exact dependency-cache measurement

One proof-only eight-minute job measures preparation, official cache save, then clean npm ci / exact restore / exact restore / clean npm ci, followed by a deliberately absent key and real install fallback. No product tests or production workflow changes are included. Its unique run/attempt compatibility key cannot write default-branch or production namespaces. Every restore must report exact success, matching primary/matched keys and matching installed readiness; any miss/error/partial/invalid result is removed and installed normally, never counted as a warm hit.

The normal npm ci command and repository postinstall remain unchanged. setup-node package-manager caching is disabled. The preparation install warms downloads and lifecycle assets; its cost is separate. Cypress has an external binary cache, retained identically for every trial and checked for executable/version/size readiness. It is deliberately not included in node_modules archives, so this is not an E2E cache design. MSW has no configured workerDirectory; esbuild, Parcel watcher, vue-demi and patch-package outputs reside inside node_modules. reo-census install telemetry remains unchanged; its requests can add install variance. No install scripts are disabled.

Validation compares all installed file paths/types/modes/sizes, symlink targets, package-manifest hashes and the seven patched-file hashes. It exercises esbuild's native transform, Parcel's native snapshot and Vite/Vitest imports. This is dependency readiness, not full test-equivalence proof or full-content hashing of every dependency. Cache archive bytes come from GitHub's cache API; action logs must corroborate transfer/compression details. Install/probe CPU/RSS uses GNU time; actions do not expose equivalent process resource accounting, so restore/save CPU is not claimed.

Each measured install/restore includes identical readiness work. Save/restore wall brackets include action-step overhead. Evidence retains raw outputs plus guarded cost arithmetic, including preparation/save amortization and miss lookup. Same-VM page/disk cache bias remains; no cross-run stability, production cache provenance, 20% saving or full-suite result is established. `eligible` requires both warm pairs faster and positive net saving in the explicitly conservative four-consumer/100%-hit model. `productionAcceptance` remains false pending complete job/family/cost review. Exact job duration includes setup/upload/post-actions, which finish after the recorded pre-upload elapsed time.

The source tree, OS/image metadata, architecture/libc, exact Node/npm/ABI, package/lock/patch/local helper files and hashes of npm configuration/install environment identify the proof input. If image-generation metadata is absent, no cross-image compatibility is inferred; the unique same-job namespace still prevents reuse across runs. No raw npm configuration or environment secrets are written. Evidence upload is bounded to128 files/32MiB with hashes. The execution budget ends90seconds before the job cap to preserve diagnostics/upload time; action and process caps are independently bounded. No cache retries or partial restore keys are configured.
